title: Classification of call-layout indices
statement: For every finite Boolean Turing machine $M$ and every physical tape index $j$ in its prepared call layout, either $j$ is the argument slot, $j$ is the capture slot, or there are a source tape $i$ of $M$ and a component $r$ among data, visited marks, and origin marks such that $j$ is the index of that component for tape $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$j$ is an index in the prepared call layout
replaced:
Every physical tape index of the clean-call layout is the argument slot, the capture
slot, or the slot of one component (data, visited, or origin) of one source bank.
